beats.label: S1 · Boat Party
beats.text: A boat party turns Liv Moore into a zombie; she abandons her medical career and her engagement to Major, and hides at the Seattle morgue for a steady brain supply.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the entire premise — Liv's cover, her losses, and why she works homicide cases.

beats.label: S1 · Ravi Allies
beats.text: Her boss Ravi discovers her secret, becomes her one confidant, and starts hunting a cure using tainted Utopium recovered from the boat party.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ravi's cure work is the engine of every future season; his loyalty is the show's spine.

beats.label: S1 · Blaine's Empire
beats.text: Blaine DeBeers — the zombie who turned Liv — builds a brain-dealing empire, killing and turning people to keep it stocked.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the show's main antagonist and the brain-market economy that persists for years.

beats.label: S1 · Lowell Dies
beats.text: Liv falls for fellow zombie Lowell; when Lowell tries to assassinate Blaine on her behalf, Blaine shoots him dead in front of her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hardens Liv against Blaine and ends her one shot at a same-kind relationship until Major.

beats.label: S1 · Major Committed
beats.text: Chasing the missing kids Blaine has been turning, Major is dismissed as insane and committed; another patient hands him proof zombies exist.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pushes Major from grief into becoming a zombie hunter — his S2 role starts here.

beats.label: S1 · Max Rager Exposed
beats.text: A reporter's murder leads Liv to Max Rager: their drink mixed with tainted Utopium at the boat party is what created zombies, and CEO Vaughn Du Clark knows it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the real villain, makes Vaughn the S2 boss, and sets Liv's blood on his kill list.

beats.label: S1 · Finale
beats.text: Liv turns dying Major into a zombie to save him, then cures him with Ravi's last dose; she cures Blaine too, and Peyton flees after seeing Liv feral.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets every core relationship for S2: Blaine cured, Major cured, Peyton gone, cure supply exhausted.

cliffhanger.text: Blaine's brain empire is a burning ruin and both he and Major are human again, but Peyton has fled after seeing Liv feed, and Max Rager knows exactly what Liv is.
questions: Will Peyton ever forgive Liv and come home?
Can Ravi remake the cure with no tainted Utopium left?
How does Vaughn Du Clark come for Liv now that he knows?

characters.name: Liv Moore
characters.line: Former medical resident turned zombie; works at the morgue as Clive's 'psychic' case consultant.

characters.name: Ravi
characters.line: Medical examiner and Liv's only ally; quietly building a zombie cure.

characters.name: Clive Babineaux
characters.line: Homicide detective who partners with Liv on cases; still does not know she is a zombie.

characters.name: Major
characters.line: Liv's ex-fiancé; briefly zombified then cured, now hardened after learning zombies are real.

characters.name: Blaine DeBeers
characters.line: The zombie who turned Liv; ran the brain empire, now human after Liv cured him and his shop was destroyed.

characters.name: Peyton
characters.line: Liv's best friend and Seattle ADA; discovered Liv is a zombie and abandoned her in horror.

characters.name: Vaughn Du Clark
characters.line: Max Rager CEO; knows his drink plus Utopium is the source of the zombie plague and wants Liv silenced.

beats.label: S2 · Three Months On
beats.text: Blaine now runs a funeral home fronting a brain-and-Utopium business, while Vaughn blackmails Major into being Max Rager's private zombie killer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the new equilibrium: Blaine as merchant, Major as hunter, both leashed to Vaughn.

beats.label: S2 · Peyton Returns
beats.text: Peyton returns to lead a task force against Utopium kingpin Mr. Boss; Blaine turns informant against Boss and the two grow close.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restarts Peyton's story, plants the Blaine/Peyton romance, and lights the Boss/Blaine war fuse.

beats.label: S2 · Gilda the Spy
beats.text: Vaughn's daughter Rita infiltrates Liv's life posing as roommate 'Gilda' and secretly sleeps with Major to keep tabs on both of them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains how Max Rager stays a step ahead all season and poisons Liv/Major's relationship.

beats.label: S2 · Cure and Freezer
beats.text: Ravi cracks a working cure that only lasts unless boosted; Major secretly freezes the zombies Vaughn orders him to kill rather than killing them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why the 'missing persons' pile up (the Chaos Killer case) and why cured zombies later revert.

beats.label: S2 · Blaine Killed and Cured
beats.text: Mr. Boss murders Blaine, who resurrects as a zombie; Ravi's new emergency cure works but wipes his memory.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Blaine's amnesiac reinvention with Peyton and the cure's dangerous side effects.

beats.label: S2 · Chaos Killer Arrested
beats.text: FBI agent Dale Bozzio identifies Major as the 'Chaos Killer' behind Seattle's missing-persons cases and arrests him; Liv reveals herself to Clive to get Major released.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Breaks the biggest secret of the show: Clive now knows, permanently changing every case.

beats.label: S2 · Vivian's Zombie Army
beats.text: At Vaughn's party, tainted Utopium and Super Max trigger a mass outbreak; Vaughn dies, and Vivian Stoll's arriving mercenary company turns out to be an all-zombie army.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Fillmore-Graves and the zombie-haven plan that drives all of S3.

cliffhanger.text: A mass zombie outbreak just tore through Max Rager, and Vivian Stoll's arriving mercenaries have revealed themselves as an all-zombie army planning to make Seattle a zombie haven.
questions: What does Vivian Stoll actually intend to do with a city full of zombies?
Now that Peyton, Clive, and Major all know Liv's secret, how long before the world does?
Can amnesiac Blaine be trusted with anything, and what happens when he remembers?

characters.name: Liv Moore
characters.line: Zombie morgue consultant; has now revealed herself to Clive to save Major.

characters.name: Ravi
characters.line: Has a temporary cure but no supply of tainted Utopium to make more.

characters.name: Clive Babineaux
characters.line: Finally knows Liv is a zombie; ally in on the whole secret.

characters.name: Major
characters.line: Exposed as the Chaos Killer, freed after Liv outed herself to Clive; re-zombified and estranged from Liv.

characters.name: Blaine DeBeers
characters.line: Killed by Mr. Boss, resurrected as a zombie, then took Ravi's emergency cure; now human with heavy memory loss.

characters.name: Peyton
characters.line: Seattle ADA leading the anti-Utopium task force; now knows about zombies and is romantically drawn to Blaine.

characters.name: Vivian Stoll
characters.line: New owner of Max Rager; leader of the Fillmore-Graves zombie mercenary company.

characters.name: Dale Bozzio
characters.line: FBI agent, Clive's girlfriend, and the one who cracked the Chaos Killer case.

characters.name: Mr. Boss
characters.line: Utopium kingpin who murdered Blaine over informant leaks; still at large and hunting his rivals.

beats.label: S3 · Fillmore-Graves Drills
beats.text: Vivian bombs Max Rager to bury the outbreak evidence, and her Fillmore-Graves company drills as a zombie army preparing for 'Discovery Day'.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the season's central question: when and how zombies go public.

beats.label: S3 · Harley Kills Wally
beats.text: Anti-zombie militants start hunting zombies after a Max Rager guard's live radio confession about the outbreak.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the human-side threat and the Wally case that drives Clive's whole season.

beats.label: S3 · Temporary Cure
beats.text: Ravi keeps developing his zombie work, worrying the cure's memory-loss side effect could erase Major for good, and later ingests a potential vaccine.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why cures keep failing and sets up his self-experiment at season's end.

beats.label: S3 · Blaine's Lie
beats.text: Blaine confesses his amnesia was faked to win Peyton; she pulls away, gutted, and their relationship collapses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Blaine's redemption arc and returns him to the merchant/villain lane he occupies afterward.

beats.label: S3 · Chase Takes Over
beats.text: Vivian is assassinated in a helicopter explosion; her brother-in-law Chase Graves takes command of Fillmore-Graves and races toward Discovery Day.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Swaps out the S2-era zombie leader for the harder-line commander who runs the next season.

beats.label: S3 · Carey Gold's Plot
beats.text: Clive and Liv trace Wally's murder and a lethal flu outbreak to FG exec Carey Gold, who engineered both to force Discovery Day; Chase kills her but keeps her plan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Solves every season mystery in one beat and locks Chase into shipping the endgame anyway.

beats.label: S3 · Discovery Day
beats.text: Fake flu vaccines turn thousands into zombies; on-air weatherman Johnny Frost — now zombie — reveals zombies to the world; Ravi tests his vaccine by having Liv scratch him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Zombies going public is the single hinge point of the show — every later season is post-Discovery.

cliffhanger.text: Zombies are public knowledge, Fillmore-Graves is mediating a fragile new peace, and Ravi has just been scratched by Liv to test whether his experimental vaccine actually holds.
questions: Did Ravi's vaccine work, or is he about to turn?
How will humans and zombies actually share Seattle now the secret is out?
What is Chase Graves' long-term plan now that he has to run a city, not fake a war?

characters.name: Liv Moore
characters.line: Still a zombie working at the morgue; now solving cases in a world that knows zombies exist.

characters.name: Ravi
characters.line: Just injected his experimental vaccine and had Liv scratch him to test it.

characters.name: Clive Babineaux
characters.line: Homicide detective; devastated by the Wally murder and working alongside his ex-girlfriend, FBI agent Dale, on the case.

characters.name: Major
characters.line: Took Ravi's cure and became human, then voluntarily turned zombie again to rejoin Fillmore-Graves.

characters.name: Blaine DeBeers
characters.line: Zombie again after Mr. Boss's failed hit, running his funeral-home brain business; abandoned by Peyton after his lie came out.

characters.name: Peyton
characters.line: Chief of staff to zombie Mayor Baracus; still tied into the city's zombie politics.

characters.name: Chase Graves
characters.line: Vivian's brother-in-law, now commander of Fillmore-Graves; killed Carey Gold but executed her Discovery Day plan anyway.

characters.name: Dale Bozzio
characters.line: FBI agent and Clive's ex-girlfriend, turned zombie by the FG flu vaccine.

characters.name: Angus DeBeers
characters.line: Blaine's estranged zombie father; imprisoned by Blaine at the bottom of a well.

beats.label: S4 · The Wall
beats.text: The US Government walls off 'New Seattle' under Chase Graves; Liv joins Mama Leone's underground railroad smuggling humans in and out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the closed-city status quo and Liv's smuggler role that becomes her identity all season.

beats.label: S4 · Brother Love Rises
beats.text: Angus escapes Blaine's well, kills a priest and takes his robes, then builds a violent zombie cult under the name 'Brother Love'.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the fanatic faction whose mass exodus triggers the finale.

beats.label: S4 · Renegade Executed
beats.text: Chase captures and publicly executes Mama Leone; Liv secretly takes over as the new Renegade, with filmmaker Levon documenting her work.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Liv into the season's symbolic leader and puts her on Chase's kill list.

beats.label: S4 · The Nuke Plot
beats.text: Major, running FG's teen zombie unit, goes undercover with black-market operator Russ Roche to identify his boss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the existential nuke threat that shadows the finale and continues past it.

beats.label: S4 · Isobel's Cure
beats.text: Isobel — a human Liv smuggled in who is scratched repeatedly but mysteriously never turns — dies; Ravi tests her brain and finds it contains a true zombie cure.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real cure of the series; every future political and medical fight orbits it.

beats.label: S4 · Major Kills Chase
beats.text: As Chase prepares to execute Liv and Levon at a public execution, Major breaks in, kills Chase, and takes command of Fillmore-Graves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Major in charge of the zombie military — his role for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S4 · Massacre and Deal
beats.text: Brother Love leads a thousand zombies over the wall to slaughter by the US Army; the government cuts brain shipments, forcing Major to strike a smuggling deal with Blaine.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Creates the brain-supply crisis and the Blaine/Major alliance that defines the next season.

cliffhanger.text: Official brain shipments to New Seattle are dead. Major now runs Fillmore-Graves and is secretly buying smuggled brains from Blaine to keep zombies fed, while Liv, publicly outed as Renegade, keeps her humans-through-the-wall operation running.
questions: How long can Major hide Blaine's smuggled brain supply from a starving city?
Now that Ravi has a real cure, who gets it, and does that make zombies safer or more hunted?
Is the government done considering the nuclear option, or is that threat still coming?

characters.name: Liv Moore
characters.line: Publicly known as Renegade; runs the human-smuggling operation and is a symbol of resistance.

characters.name: Major
characters.line: New commander of Fillmore-Graves after killing Chase; secretly dependent on Blaine to feed the city.

characters.name: Ravi
characters.line: Has a true zombie cure at last — from Isobel's brain — but relapses into zombie form 72 hours a month as a side effect of his own vaccine.

characters.name: Clive Babineaux
characters.line: Homicide detective; just married Dale, who Liv cured with the first dose of Isobel's brain.

characters.name: Blaine DeBeers
characters.line: Brain-market kingpin of New Seattle; has just cut a deal with Major to smuggle brains into the walled city.

characters.name: Peyton
characters.line: Left New Seattle for Washington DC as acting mayor, disowned by her family.

characters.name: Dale Bozzio
characters.line: Cured by Liv on her wedding day to Clive; human again.

characters.name: Don E
characters.line: Blaine's chief lieutenant, running the Scratching Post and Blaine's operations day-to-day.

characters.name: Levon Patch
characters.line: Filmmaker and Liv's boyfriend; falsely confessed to being Renegade to save her.

beats.label: S5 · Blaine Controls the Supply
beats.text: Blaine's smuggling deal with Major makes him the sole supplier of brains to New Seattle, while anti-zombie extremists — the 'Dead Enders' — begin suicide attacks on FG checkpoints.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the season's power geometry: Blaine on top, FG under attack, war brewing.

beats.label: S5 · The Cure Race
beats.text: CDC scientist Charli, sent to help Ravi, reveals she has also discovered the cure — but warns that mass-producing it means Freylich teens get harvested for their brains.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Freylich harvest concept that Blaine builds his season plot around.

beats.label: S5 · Supremacists and Enzo
beats.text: Fillmore-Graves splinters: Commander Enzo defects to zombie supremacists led by Liv's estranged father Martin, who created the original zombifying formula.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's zombie-side antagonists and ties them personally to Liv.

beats.label: S5 · Freylich Harvest
beats.text: Blaine starts contracting Freylich teens for their postmortem brains, tries to threaten journalist Al after her exposé but is rebuffed, and murders Don E's girlfriend Darcy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in Blaine's villainy and plants the personal grievance that gets him killed.

beats.label: S5 · Peyton's Show Saves Seattle
beats.text: As Washington debates nuking Seattle, a US committee chair sees her grandson watching Peyton's zombie-friendly kids' show and casts the deciding vote to keep brain shipments coming.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the nuclear threat and sets up the Zombie Island resolution.

beats.label: S5 · Blaine in the Well
beats.text: Peyton, shot fighting Blaine's operation, is turned zombie by Blaine to save her life; on learning Blaine killed Darcy, Don E and Liv push him into the same well he trapped his father in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the show's oldest antagonist and completes his father-parallel arc.

beats.label: S5 · Ten Years Later
beats.text: Major fakes taking the cure on camera to end the human-zombie war. A decade later, he and Liv raise children on Zombie Island and offer the cure — and their pseudo-immortality — to their old friends.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Series resolution: coexistence is achieved and the core group choose their own version of forever.

cliffhanger.text: The war is over: Blaine is dead, Enzo is dead, the cure is real, and ten years on Liv and Major have found a way for their found family to stay together on Zombie Island.
questions: Does human-zombie coexistence actually hold once the founding leaders are gone?
Will Peyton, Ravi, Clive and Dale take Liv and Major up on the offer of pseudo-immortality?
What happens to the Freylich kids now that their brains remain the world's only source of the cure?

characters.name: Liv Moore
characters.line: Zombie; raising children with Major on Zombie Island a decade after the war ended.

characters.name: Major
characters.line: Still a zombie — his on-camera 'cure' was Max Rager — living with Liv on Zombie Island.

characters.name: Ravi
characters.line: Human, mass-producing the cure and now leading the CDC.

characters.name: Clive Babineaux
characters.line: Human; married to Dale and raising Michelle's son with her in San Francisco.

characters.name: Peyton
characters.line: Turned zombie by Blaine to save her life; now an attorney in Atlanta.

characters.name: Dale Bozzio
characters.line: Cured, married to Clive, raising their adopted son.

characters.name: Don E
characters.line: Blaine's former lieutenant; killed Blaine for murdering Darcy and inherited what remained of his business.

characters.name: Blaine DeBeers
characters.line: Dead — pushed by Don E and Liv into the well he used on his father.
